title: Privacy Policy
intro: This privacy policy explains how NestSelf processes personal data collected through this website. We process your data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the Serbian Law on Personal Data Protection (ZZPL, Zakon o zaštiti podataka o ličnosti) and the Hungarian Act CXII of 2011 on Informational Self-Determination and Freedom of Information (Info tv.).

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: [Company name], registered at [Address].
Serbia: Matični broj [Matični broj], PIB [PIB].
Hungary: Cégjegyzékszám [Cégjegyzékszám], Adószám [Adószám].
Data protection officer: [DPO name and contact — to be appointed before launch].
Contact: hello@nestself.example

sections.heading: 2. What data we process
paragraphs: Through this website we process the following categories of personal data:
bullets: Demo request forms: name, work email, company name, job title, company size, country, optional message
Contact forms: name, email, subject, message
Webinar registration forms: name, email, optional company name
A functional cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) that remembers your language preference

sections.heading: 3. Wellbeing check-ins
paragraphs: The wellbeing check-in questionnaires on this website run entirely in your browser. Your answers and results are never sent to our servers. NestSelf does not store, transmit or process any check-in data.

Because no health data leaves your device, this website does not process special-category data under GDPR Article 9 or ZZPL Article 17. No explicit consent for health-data processing is required for the use of this website.

sections.heading: 4. Purposes and legal bases
paragraphs: We process your data for the following purposes:
bullets: To respond to your demo request or message: GDPR Article 6(1)(b) (pre-contractual measures) and Article 6(1)(f) (legitimate interest in responding to enquiries)
To send webinar confirmations and reminders: GDPR Article 6(1)(b)
To remember your language preference: GDPR Article 6(1)(f) (legitimate interest in a functional website experience)

sections.heading: 5. Automated decision-making
paragraphs: This website does not carry out automated decision-making or profiling as defined by GDPR Article 22.

sections.heading: 6. Analytics and marketing cookies
paragraphs: This website does not set analytics or marketing cookies. The only cookie used is NEXT_LOCALE, a strictly functional cookie that stores your preferred language. See our Cookie Policy for details.

sections.heading: 7. Retention
paragraphs: Contact and demo request data is retained for as long as necessary to respond to your enquiry and for a reasonable period afterwards for follow-up, unless you ask us to delete it sooner. Webinar registration data is retained for the duration of the webinar series and deleted within 12 months of the last event.

sections.heading: 8. Recipients and processors
paragraphs: Your data may be processed by the following categories of service providers:
bullets: Hosting provider: [to be named before launch]
Email service provider: [to be named before launch]

sections.heading: 9. International transfers
paragraphs: If any of our processors transfer personal data outside the European Economic Area (EEA), we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place, such as Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission. Details of any such transfers will be documented here before launch.

sections.heading: 10. Whether providing your data is required
paragraphs: Providing your personal data through the demo request, contact or webinar registration forms is voluntary. You are not under a statutory or contractual obligation to provide it. If you choose not to fill in the required fields, we may not be able to respond to your enquiry or register you for a webinar.

sections.heading: 11. Data protection impact assessment
paragraphs: A data protection impact assessment (DPIA) has been conducted in accordance with GDPR Article 35, taking into account the NAIH mandatory DPIA list (Article 35(4) list). A summary is available on request by contacting us at hello@nestself.example.

sections.heading: 12. Your rights
paragraphs: Under the GDPR and the ZZPL you have the right to:
bullets: Access the personal data we hold about you
Withdraw consent at any time (where processing is based on consent)

sections.heading: 13. How to exercise your rights
paragraphs: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at hello@nestself.example. We will respond within 30 days.

sections.heading: 14. Supervisory authorities
paragraphs: If you believe your data protection rights have been violated, you have the right to lodge a complaint with:
bullets: Serbia: Poverenik za informacije od javnog značaja i zaštitu podataka o ličnosti (Commissioner for Information of Public Importance and Personal Data Protection), www.poverenik.rs
Hungary: Nemzeti Adatvédelmi és Információszabadság Hatóság (NAIH), www.naih.hu

sections.heading: 15. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows the last revision.

sections.heading: 16. Contact
paragraphs: For any questions about this privacy policy, contact us at hello@nestself.example.
